question: What is the primary aim of Regional Rural Banks in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Development of rural economy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Development of rural economy** is the primary aim of **Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)** in India.
 
• RRBs were established to provide sufficient banking and credit facilities for agriculture and other rural sectors.
